title: 19th Day
categoryChain: Everyday short duas in the month of Ramadhan

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ وَفِّرْ فِيْهِ حَظِّيْ مِنْ بَرَكَاتِهِ،
verses.translation: O Allah, on this day, (please) save me a share of its blessings,
make easy my way to the obtainment of its goodness,
and do not deprive me of Your approval of the good deeds (that I do on this day).
O He Who guides to the evident truth!
